title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Eri Wild Force 091/071 Super Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Eri (Biwa) Supporter SR 091/071 - sv5K Wild Force

Japanese-language Super Rare (SR) full-art Supporter/Trainer card from the Scarlet & Violet expansion sv5K "Wild Force" (2024). Eri is the boss of Team Star's Fighting-type crew (Caph Squad).

Card text: Look at your opponent's hand. Choose up to 2 Item cards from it and discard them. (Supporter - only 1 per turn.)

- Character: Eri / Biwa (ビワ)
- Card type: Trainer - Supporter
- Rarity: Super Rare (SR) - full art
- Card number: 091/071
- Set: sv5K Wild Force (Japanese)
- Illustrator: GOSSAN
- Ungraded, raw single

Condition: Pulled and sleeved straight away, handled by the edges. Front and back are both photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.
